provider.id: <from the provider in use at role resolution>
provider.termsRef: <the row of the provider, or null>

auth.credential: secret reference, named by the consumer

preflight.skipped: no endpoint is called before a pass; the key reaches pi by environment only (research.md row 10)
preflight.reportsPresenceOf: the credential of the role, never its value
preflight.missingFails: before the first pass, naming what is missing

auth.note: API key by environment from the provider's key variable; never an argument; no auth file read; no login

models.listSource: probed: the model list of pi, context column

contextWindow.source: probed or declared; the smaller wins

critic.secondForm: not offered: the read-only tool selection of pi is a tool allow-list, not an operating-system sandbox (annex C §C.3; R9 F8)
critic.proof: the initial record of the stream; where it states no tool list, the weaker proof by the exact pin, a passed preflight and the flag set (Principle IX v3.0.1; CQ-182)

automaticPick.providerRow: required: the row of the provider in use must allow it; a provider whose terms are unknown is never picked automatically
automaticPick.metered: an automatic pick on a metered provider carries the hard spending cap (F100-FR-093)

proposer.permission: none: pi has no permission mode
proposer.laterVersionDefault: off until the descriptor lists the tool
proposer.toolStatus: unverified (tool names read from the documentation of pi; the allow-list, never a deny list, is the rule — research.md row 3)
proposer.projectLocalResources: untrusted for both roles: the approval option is never passed (the argv carries --no-approve), project trust is never set, and the explicit ignore flags --no-extensions, --no-skills, --no-context-files and --no-prompt-templates are passed by default

critic.projectLocalResources: untrusted for both roles: the approval option is never passed, project trust is never set, and the explicit setting that ignores project-local resources is passed; the print-mode default alone is not relied on
critic.memoryAndContext: harness-native memory and context files off for EVERY critic call, recorded per call
critic.session: never shared with a pass: the identity of the critic call is minted apart from every pass

contextWindow.inUse: the smaller of the declared and the effective window
contextWindow.unknownModel: no default; pi is NOT offered as critic on a model with no known window

continuation.how: exact id by the session-id option; a session directory per phase attempt

failures.agent_failure: terminal record with stop reason error and no class matched

envAllow: <the key variable of the provider in use>
isolation.credentialCrossRole: never: the credentials of the critic are never in the environment of the proposer, and the reverse

home.tier1: the real home, never written by the run
home.tier2: a throwaway home built from the overlay, removed after the call, a killed pass included
home.credentialByEnvironmentOnly: no auth file is copied between homes

containment.refusedWithoutOptIn: the launch of pi as proposer is refused with the reason and a doctor line, and no pass starts

memory.off: context files and extensions off; whether pi has memory beyond them is a capture-4 side check
